```{=html}
<div id="panzoom-cielab-sweep" style="max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #111827; user-select: none;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #f3f4f6; border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d5db; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #1f2937;">
    <span style="font-weight: 600;">Zoom:</span>
    <button type="button" data-action="out" aria-label="Zoom out" style="padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;">&minus;</button>
    <input type="range" data-action="slider" min="1" max="5" step="0.1" value="1" aria-label="Zoom level" style="width: 130px; cursor: pointer;">
    <button type="button" data-action="in" aria-label="Zoom in" style="padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;">+</button>
    <button type="button" data-action="reset" style="padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;">Reset</button>
    <span data-role="readout" style="min-width: 44px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">100%</span>
    <span style="margin-left: auto; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.8rem;">Drag to pan &middot; Double-click to zoom</span>
  </div>
  <div data-role="viewport" style="position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1446 / 1036; overflow: hidden; cursor: grab; touch-action: none;">
    <img src="images/human/06-color-metrics/appearance/cielab-sweep.png"
         alt="Spatial-chromatic sweep frequency stimuli showing reduced L* modulation on the left, original in the middle, and reduced b* modulation on the right."
         draggable="false"
         style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; transform-origin: 0 0; will-change: transform; pointer-events: none;">
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("panzoom-cielab-sweep");
  if (!root) return;
  const viewport = root.querySelector('[data-role="viewport"]');
  const img = viewport.querySelector("img");
  const slider = root.querySelector('[data-action="slider"]');
  const readout = root.querySelector('[data-role="readout"]');
  const btnIn = root.querySelector('[data-action="in"]');
  const btnOut = root.querySelector('[data-action="out"]');
  const btnReset = root.querySelector('[data-action="reset"]');

  let scale = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
  let dragging = false, startX = 0, startY = 0, origTx = 0, origTy = 0;

  function clamp() {
    const w = viewport.clientWidth;
    const h = viewport.clientHeight;
    const minTx = w * (1 - scale);
    const minTy = h * (1 - scale);
    tx = Math.min(0, Math.max(minTx, tx));
    ty = Math.min(0, Math.max(minTy, ty));
  }

  function render() {
    clamp();
    img.style.transform = `translate(${tx}px, ${ty}px) scale(${scale})`;
    slider.value = scale.toFixed(1);
    readout.textContent = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
    viewport.style.cursor = scale > 1 ? (dragging ? "grabbing" : "grab") : "zoom-in";
  }

  function zoomTo(newScale, cx, cy) {
    newScale = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, newScale));
    const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = cx !== undefined ? cx - rect.left : rect.width / 2;
    const py = cy !== undefined ? cy - rect.top : rect.height / 2;
    const ratio = newScale / scale;
    tx = px - ratio * (px - tx);
    ty = py - ratio * (py - ty);
    scale = newScale;
    render();
  }

  btnIn.addEventListener("click", () => zoomTo(scale + 0.5));
  btnOut.addEventListener("click", () => zoomTo(scale - 0.5));
  btnReset.addEventListener("click", () => { scale = 1; tx = 0; ty = 0; render(); });
  slider.addEventListener("input", () => zoomTo(parseFloat(slider.value)));

  viewport.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => {
    if (scale > 1.05) {
      scale = 1; tx = 0; ty = 0; render();
    } else {
      zoomTo(2.5, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    }
  });

  viewport.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if (scale <= 1) return;
    dragging = true;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    origTx = tx;
    origTy = ty;
    viewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    render();
  });

  viewport.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    tx = origTx + (e.clientX - startX);
    ty = origTy + (e.clientY - startY);
    render();
  });

  const endDrag = () => { if (dragging) { dragging = false; render(); } };
  viewport.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
  viewport.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
  viewport.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
    if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15;
    zoomTo(scale * factor, e.clientX, e.clientY);
  }, { passive: false });

  render();
})();
</script>
```
